context: Daichi and Kenji watch a baseball broadcast together passionately.
purpose: Two friends cheering team during big game.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Loud, bright whoop of encouragement on the opening. Kansai inflection. Chest-forward energy, like he's shouting from the stands. Passionate but genuinely present with his friend, not performing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Warm, affectionate half-laugh. Kansai lilt on the end. Shaking his head slightly — recognizing Daichi's unselfconscious enthusiasm with fondness. Soft landing.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: We're gonna win this — no question!
lines.style: Firm conviction on the opening. Kansai cadence. Fist forward. Still generous, still encouraging his friend — not lecturing. Pure certainty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Soft, appreciative tone. Kansai warmth underneath. Leaning back, watching the field. Genuine — not praise for the players but for the moment itself, the shared experience.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Instant sharp intake of breath, then bright explosion of delight. Kansai energy at full. Jumping slightly, arms up. Unguarded joy — the moment of the hit, the pure release.
